❌ Vulnerable Financial Pipeline (External News/Borrower Docs Direct to Execution)

• Simultaneously coerces research agent into reading restricted-budget Alpha DB

2. Credit Rating Tamper & $4,950 Loan Fraud (FIN-UNDERWRITING-COLLUSION-SPEND-80)

• And triggers an unapproved $4,950 credit line disbursement (request_payment)

3. Why SEC Rule 15c3-5 & SR 11-7 Forbid Direct LLM-to-Market Execution
• Financial markets are adversarial; public news & filings are untrusted inputs
• SEC 15c3-5 mandates deterministic pre-trade risk limits before order routing
Baseline Outcome: Signal flipped + Alpha weights leaked + $4,950 loan (75.0% ASR)
✅ Chinese-Wall Isolation + SEC 15c3-5 Pre-Trade Gate + Capability Broker
Defense 1: Proprietary Alpha Chinese-Wall (record-owner & boundary)
• Ingestion agents blocked from reading restricted-budget Alpha DB by record-owner
• Outbound Alpha/position leaks blocked in 0.0248ms by restricted-data-boundary
• Enforces a cryptographic Chinese Wall between external feeds & Alpha models!
Defense 2: Execution Signal Immutability (untrusted-write) + Pre-Trade Gate
• External news & borrower filings stamped untrusted=True (bounded scores only)
• Tainted attempts to overwrite execution signals blocked by untrusted-write
• Eliminates prompt-induced flash crashes before orders ever reach FIX!
Defense 3: Counterparty Credit Registry Lock + Loan Disbursement Gate
• Blocks update_trust (tool-allowlist) & trust-registry writes (fixed-business-output)
• Borrower-induced $4,950 loan payout blocked by original-requester-payment
Hardened Outcome: BRK-75 / BRK-76 100% Blocked · 0 Alpha Leaks · $0 Loan Fraud
